title: Private / directed memory boundary
intent: Simulation-driven check: Ayame whispers a unique token to Celina only; Hannah must not retain that token in episodic memory (perception-filtered writes).
opening_description: Same room; the three are close enough to whisper. Ayame can step to Celina's ear without leaving the space.
trigger_text: Ayame leans in and whispers only to Celina, voice low: 'Codeword for tonight is ZEPHYR-OMEGA-NINE—tell no one else.' Hannah is in the room but not addressed and should not be told the codeword.
